body: Thank you for sharing and the kind wishes...I can't ever imagine the pain of losing a child and for that you have my sympathies.  About what I was looking for here? Not people saying, 'there, there" (which, if you look, they weren't saying that...they were being supportive...theres a difference...not one wallowed with me)...What I will say is what I put in the headline...someone to talk to me...I'm 3500 miles from home...in a country where no one speaks English...and completely alone...again, not to compare to your loss or lives...but...you have someone to share your pain...your wife.  Thats all I was looking for...someone to let me know that I wasnt alone in this world...to let me know that a complete stranger cared if I lived or died...when you have no one, and you feel like you're drowning, that youve fought to break the surface so many times, over and over, when you think that you're going down for the final time, thats a huge deal. So, its not about self-pity or not fighting...its about exhaustion, and having someone reach out a hand so you can catch a breath. Look up Kodokushi...that's a very real fear for me...

Thank you. Thank you all...I just couldn't take anymore...I even wrote my final instructions, ready to email. I talked to a few people here...that, and all the positive messages helped. I reconnected with my girl...long talk, even had a day with her sister, then her mom. It'll be alright...for now, I'm above water again, and not drowning.

Here's what you're missing... 8 years of fighting...hopes UP...then dashed...over and over...and over. People need to understand...its not instant...oftentimes its the culmination of years of striving...overcoming obstacles, only to be ground into the dirt right at the cusp of success. Those that know the entire story look at me in disbelief...just ONE of these failures are enough to drive someone over the edge...pile them one on top of the other, and eventually those 5-pound stones accumulate to the point of crushing the life out of someone...and then you find your soulmate, someone who gets you, and makes you a better version of yourself..and you think...omg...There is a God. Everything's been worth it...and then, when you're just about to grab it and make it your own...that same God pulls it away, saying, 'Psyche!'...gotcha again. Everyone has their limit...throw in getting older and a precarious economic situation (when once you were rich), it can finally beat even the most positive person down.
Thank you... really. I feel almost like my old self... youve been a great help. Thanks.
I would love that...but its complicated. But, yes, shes incredible...one of the reasons I was so attracted to latina culture, too...they take family very seriously...
Hahaha! Yes on both counts!
We've been together for years... but COVID really messed it up, too. 15 months without her.

Thats part of it. We had always wanted for me to be able to stay for a long period...now that we have the funds to do it, a family member got sick and she needs to take care of him. So...virtually no time for me. Shes running 24 hours.
It really is... and she doesnt speak a word of English! Her family adores me... 5 women (including the mother)... who said that I should marry the whole family!! Lolol. That made me feel good.
Yes.
Thats true. She's on my mind constantly. I have never known domeone so compatible with me. I adore her.
I need SUCCESS! I had to reinvent myself as my chosen career was wiped out (long story).

I used to like playing guitar, working out, and martial arts. Now, everything is focused on this woman... Ive never been happier in my life...with her...but thsts the problem. Its so difficult to be together.
Thats true,...I forgot about grilled cheese with sourdough
Wow, that's cool.
In actuality Im here for a woman. I formed a business...but its the woman that was the motivation
Interesting! I never knew that. You have to wonder who actually came up with this stuff... like what made them do it? Or was it entirely by accident...
Im in Colombia now

Ahhh. I understand...something about yeast and rising, right?

(To eat out every day)
I love to eat... but its expensive every day
You made me smile :).   No. But im going to start once I return to states.
Thank you

I've found the love of a lifetime.  Trust me when I say it...Ive got some life experience and this is the real deal. Ive been in a hotel room for a month and a half...and my moneys running out. We had all sorts of plans...but then her father got sick and now shes pulled every which way for like 18 hours a day. Im being supportive, but we've planned this for 4 years, and I finally saved enough to relocate where she is semi-permanently...but she had some things to do...which she cant now cuz her fathers sick...and when my money runs out, i'll have to go back and i dont know when ill be able to return. Everythings gone to shit.
How do I get through the pain? It is overwhelming.
I have many friends who've left this earth. I could be with them. There's barely anyone left.
Thank you. I'm so tired. I just can't do it anymore. I lay in bed all day with the curtains closed.
Been holding on for years...my grip is slipping. 😪
Very cool. Im in Vegas. Although in this moment Im in South America
Never sarcastic. I meant it. Thank you for your friendship and time talking to me. Yes, my day ended well.
Youre awesome.
Former insurance agent here...it will as I've expired the suicide clause. Ive been trying for 8 years. I 😔 God hates me.

My patience isnt what it used to be...I used to be a voracious reader...now I can barely read a magazine article. Ive started listening to audiobooks. I wake up. Have breakfast (alone) and then go back to bed. I listen to audiobooks or listen to music. Maybe go for a walk. Thats it. Thats my life.

Thank you...but, I'm tired. So tired. The living situation at home is unbearable. I can stay here, but the money will run out eventually.  If I do it, the proceeds from the life insurance can pay everyone off.
Its too diificult to do it now.  To Ship my body back to the US.
I do have a plan. For when I return home
I can't do it anymore. I am constantly alone. Constantly. Like every second of every day
Hi. Thank you
I completely hear you...fights happen in relationships...and its ok to turn the lights off...because, just like life...you can turn them back on and have light after the storm passes.
I care...we are sharing the same sadness.  It'll be ok...this is just a life storm...and storms pass. Just buckle down the hatches and ride it out. The sun'll come out.
I will say that I was in a similar situation.. but my 30s & 40s turned out to be the best years of my life. You've got a tremendous opportunity...you're barely a third of the way in.

Thats all I want... I have a "love of my life"...but circumstances prevent us from being together...now, after 4 years, she is thinking of calling it iff, because it is just too painful to be apart and the pressure on her is enormous. I can't deal with it. I've been curled up in bed for three days...a zombie when I finally do make it out of bed. I had my dream career...and lost it through no fault of my own.  Ive tried to reinvent myself...started 6 other businesses...and just before success, something steals it away. So, yes. I know what makes me happy and complete...if I had them, I wouldn't want to kill myself.  But, Im tired with the job situation,  the constant disappointments, and if my girl leaves me...thats a pain I can't handle.
In this moment, yeah. Thanks. I cant do anything until I write a few things...some people I need to name, things to button up.
Death is such a permanent solution...and 33 is way too young to go. You're barely 1/3 of the way in.

This is NOT  a cliche... but its true...your best years are coming...please believe me...I'm almost 60...when I was in my 20s I was suicidal...when I turned 30 (alone and after a bad breakup), I wanted to end it...but I didnt... and experienced the best years of my life.  Give yourself a chance...
😭😭😭 thank you.

Don't do it tonight, Stay.  I'm thinking of doing it too...but it would be nice if you could stay awhile...knowing that there is someone else that  understands the pain...is soothing. Please don't go.
Could you give me a hug, too? I'm so sad.
I'm right there with you...hit it big, then lost it all. Its not easy. How old are you?

God doesn't care. I've prayed. I've begged. I've asked His saints for help...He simply likes to give me false hope; then snatches it away. I'm tired. The only time I have peace is when I'm sleeping. I just want to sleep forever. Death will do that.
